full_prompt_en: A dramatic fantasy comic illustration thrusts a massive stone-skinned guardian toward the viewer inside a dim, ruined hall. Its broad angular head occupies the upper center, with two narrow amber eyes burning from deep sockets; a heavily muscled arm and enlarged hand push into the lower-right foreground. The other hand cups a turbulent knot of turquoise light at the lower left, where thin electric ribbons curl through the fingers and across the chest. Blue-gray skin or armor is divided into broad beveled planes, small cracks, and controlled dark contour lines, giving the body a carved yet flexible weight. A golden band wraps the wrist, a small warm accent amid the dominant cool palette. Behind the figure, tall arched windows and battered masonry are visible through blue-green gloom, but the environment remains subordinate to the advancing silhouette. Amber window light echoes the eyes, while the magical glow casts cyan highlights along the jaw, shoulder, knuckles, and fissures. The foreground hand is sharply foreshortened and cropped by the frame, creating immediate scale; the head, shoulders, and two hands make a powerful triangular arrangement around the luminous energy. Fine comic linework and painterly digital shading work together, with crisp structural edges beside soft fog and translucent glow. The composition drives from the dark arch above into the lit face, then coils around the hands in a restless circular motion. The whole frame feels formidable and electrically alive, with saturated light giving the heavy figure surprising movement.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅戏剧化的奇幻漫画插画中，一名庞大的石肤守卫从昏暗、破败的大厅里扑向观者。棱角分明的宽大头颅占据上部中央，两只狭长琥珀色眼睛在深眼窝里燃烧；肌肉发达的手臂和放大的手掌伸进右下前景。另一只手在左下捧着翻腾的青绿色光团，细细的电光带穿过手指并卷过胸前。蓝灰色皮肤或护甲被分成宽阔的斜切平面、细小裂纹和受控的深色轮廓，令身体既像石雕又保持灵活的重量。手腕围着金色带饰，是占主导冷色调中的一处小暖色。人物后方，高耸拱窗和受损砌石透过蓝绿色幽暗仍可见，但环境居于前冲剪影之后。琥珀色窗光呼应眼睛，魔法辉光则沿下颌、肩膀、指节和裂隙投下青蓝高光。前景手被强烈透视缩短，并由画框裁切，立即建立尺度；头、肩和两只手围绕发光能量形成有力三角布局。纤细漫画线条与绘画式数码明暗共同工作，清晰结构边缘旁是柔软雾气与透明辉光。构图从上方深色拱门冲向明亮面孔，再以躁动的圆形运动环绕双手。整幅画威严而充满电能，饱和光色给厚重人物带来出人意料的动感。
style_prompt_en: A dramatic fantasy comic illustration combines fine controlled linework, beveled sculptural planes, and painterly digital shading. Broad blue-gray and navy masses are cut by turquoise-cyan energy ribbons and a few amber-gold light accents. Crisp cracks and structural edges coexist with translucent bloom, soft haze, and deep recessed shadow. Strong foreshortening, cropped foreground volume, and a triangular core build forceful movement around a bright focal knot. The whole frame feels heavy, electric, and vividly dimensional.
style_prompt_zh: 一幅戏剧化的奇幻漫画插画结合纤细受控的线条、斜切的雕塑般平面与绘画式数码明暗。宽阔的蓝灰和海军蓝团块被青绿至青蓝色能量带切开，并有少量琥珀金光点缀。清晰裂纹和结构边缘与透明辉光、柔软雾气及深暗凹处共存。强烈透视缩短、被裁切的前景体积和三角形核心围绕明亮焦点建立有力动势。整幅画厚重、带电且立体鲜明。
theme_en: A stone-skinned guardian gathers turquoise energy in a ruined hall
theme_zh: 石肤守卫在废弃大厅中聚集青绿色能量
name: Paul Pelletier
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
